content: Akanksha Bhatt requested the proof of insurance for her auto policy (AP-123456) for a loan, which Karan Joshi provided via PDF link. Akanksha also inquired about the claims process, learning she can file 24/7 through the portal or app by uploading photos and a police report without extra forms. Finally, she asked about the coverage details of the roadside assistance rider, which Karan confirmed includes up to 5 towing trips, lockout assistance, fuel delivery up to $50, and battery jump-starts for $12 a month.
